data.one_liner: A tiny, secure, URL-friendly, unique string ID generator.
data.what_it_does: Generates unique string IDs in Dart with support for custom alphabets, custom lengths, async generation, and non-secure modes. It is a Dart port of the popular ai/nanoid library.
use_when: You need unique, URL-friendly string identifiers
You require custom ID lengths or custom alphabets
avoid_when: You specifically require standard UUID formats (use uuid instead)
strengths: Tiny and lightweight with no dependencies
Supports secure, non-secure, and async generation APIs
weaknesses: Limited scope restricted entirely to ID generation

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need standard Universally Unique Identifiers (UUID) instead of compact URL-friendly IDs.
